description: This file defines the Week class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the calculation for date and time functions related to week numbers (e.g., WEEKNUM and ISOWEEKNUM). It provides methods to calculate the week number of a given date according to different standards, as well as the day of the week, handling various input formats and edge cases.

classes.name: Week
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate week numbers and weekdays for given dates, supporting different standards like ISO.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Calculates the week number for a given date with support for various starting week options.

methods.name: isoWeekNumber
methods.description: Returns the ISO 8601 week number for a given date.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Returns the day of the week for a given date, according to specified style (1-3).
